text:
Olga Petrova: quick follow-up from the canary this morning — we hit a streaming stall when a safetensors blob was served inside gzip. stream-loader assumed raw safetensors and blocked waiting for frames.
Mike Chen: ugh. did the HTTP layer return content-length?
Olga Petrova: yes, `content-length: 0` for the range probe in one codepath (bug in proxy), so loader treated it as streamable but decoder failed.
Sara Patel: that aligns with the customer report (partial response -> OOM on worker).
Lee Wong: proposal: add a tiny HEAD-based "format-probe" handshake before starting streaming hotloads. HEAD returns a header `x-rw-format-probe: <format-id>` so loader can pick index-first vs stream-first.
Mike Chen: format-id enum: `sf`, `sf+gz`, `tgz`, `tar`, `bin`. keep it tiny.
Sara Patel: can we avoid an extra roundtrip for high-QPS hotstarts? overhead matters.
Olga Petrova: probe should be cached at edge for TTL (60s) and loader can do a fast-range probe (first 512 bytes) when HEAD not available.
Lee Wong: fallback tiers: 1) HEAD probe + cached header, 2) small-range GET inline, 3) start streaming with short decode timeout and abort to switch to index-first.
Mike Chen: runbook: if probe header missing/conflicting, prefer index-first. streaming opt-in for verified registries.
Sara Patel: telemetry: tag `probe=head|range|none` and `decision=stream|index`. add SLOs for probe latency.
Olga Petrova: heuristics: if size < 1MB and no `content-encoding: gzip`, allow direct streaming. else prefer index-first.
Lee Wong: impl tasks: edge TTL cache, loader tiered probe, probe telemetry, runbook update.
Mike Chen: assign @Mike and @Lee loader changes; Olga takes edge cache TTL; Sara owns telemetry/runbook.
infra-bot: created ISSUE-ML-1245: "format-probe HEAD header + tiered fallback" assigned to Mike Chen, Lee Wong, Olga Petrova, Sara Patel. ETA: 2 sprints.
Mike Chen: note: third-party registries won't set header; loader must handle unknowns gracefully.
Lee Wong: add local loader probe cache to dedupe HEADs across concurrent hotstarts on host.
Olga Petrova: test plan: unit header parsing, integration with gzipped safetensors, chaos test where HEAD OK but range truncated.
Sara Patel: plan canary 1% Dedicated for two weeks before rollout.
Mike Chen: I'll open PR with loader interface sketch and header proto.
Olga Petrova: thanks — will sync on PR thread. :thumbsup:
